sloka: ताः तु यौवन शालिन्यो रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः ।उद्यान भूमिम् आगम्य प्रावृषि इव शतह्रदाः ॥१-३२-१२॥
transliteration: tāḥ tu yauvana śālinyo rūpavatyaḥ svalaṁkṛtāḥ ।udyāna bhūmim āgamya prāvṛṣi iva śatahradāḥ ॥1-32-12॥

translations.english: Those welladorned, beautiful, young maidens in the pleasuregarden looked like lightnings in the rainy season. Bedecked with fine ornaments they were singing, dancing, playing on instruments and moving in all directions in great delight.
